normalized_matching_profile.name: The Pearl on Grove
normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “The Pearl on Grove,” a bright and breezy Seagrove Beach getaway just a 2-minute stroll to the sand. Enjoy a private pool, 4 bikes for exploring 30A, and a spacious layout with 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and a cheerful twin loft—perfect for families or friends. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Heart of Seagrove Beach: Nestled in one of 30A’s most beloved communities—quiet, scenic, and just a short stroll to the shore3-Min Bike Ride to Seaside: Cruise down scenic 30A to iconic Seaside in minutes—perfect for lunch, shopping, or sunset cocktailsPrivate Pool + Outdoor Fun: Seasonally heated pool, ping pong table, gas grill, and lounge space—ideal for days spent outdoorsMultiple Dining Spaces: Indoor table for 8, sunny breakfast nook for 4, and patio dining for 6 make gathering easy and enjoyableBikes Included: Comes with 4 adult bikes—explore 30A’s coastal paths and local shops right from your doorstepRoom for the Whole Crew: Comfortably sleeps 8 with 3 private bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and a cozy twin loft perfect for kidsSteps from Convenience: Just 3 minutes to Publix at WaterColor Crossing and a quick bike ride to dining, nature trails, and more*** LIVING AREAS ***Step into a warm and welcoming space where natural light pours through the windows and cozy coastal style sets the tone for your stay. Whether you're gathering for movie night, playing board games, or simply unwinding after the beach, this open living area offers the perfect place to connect and relax.Open-concept living and dining areaSmart TV and plush, family-friendly seatingSeamless access to outdoor spaces for indoor-outdoor living*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The kitchen offers everything you need to enjoy meals at home during your beach getaway. Outfitted with stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops, it’s both functional and inviting. Dine together indoors at the large table, enjoy casual bites at the breakfast nook, or take things outside for a meal on the patio.Fully equipped kitchen with modern stainless appliancesDining table with seating for 8Breakfast nook with seating for 4Outdoor dining table with seating for 6*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Enjoy sunny days and peaceful evenings in your own backyard retreat. Whether you're cooling off in the private, seasonally heated pool, enjoying a casual game of ping pong, or dining under the stars, this outdoor space is designed for comfort and connection.Private, seasonally heated poolFenced-in backyard with lounge chairs and patio seatingPing pong table for hours of family funGas grill and shaded dining area for 6*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st FloorQueen Guest Suite: Queen-size bed and flat-screen TVGuest Bathroom: Single vanity and walk-in shower2nd FloorPrimary Suite: King-size bed, flat screen TV, private balcony access, and En-suite bathroom with dual vanities and a shower/tub comboQueen Guest Suite: Queen-size bed, flat screen TV, and private En-suite bathroom with walk-in shower and single vanity3rd FloorTwin Loft: Open loft area with two twin beds, a desk, and flat screen TV—ideal for kids or remote work*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Tucked into the heart of Seagrove Beach, this home places you minutes from everything that makes 30A unforgettable. Pedal to Seaside for sunset cocktails, grab fresh groceries in a flash, or explore scenic trails and tranquil lakes—all just around the corner.2-minute walk to public beach access—soft sands and emerald waters await3-minute bike ride to Seaside’s charming shops, eateries, and beachfront views3-minute drive to WaterColor Crossings & Publix for easy errandsTimpoochee Trail nearby—perfect for morning rides or evening strollsEastern Lake just minutes away for paddleboarding, kayaking, and fishingDine local at Cafe Thirty-A, Seagrove Village Market Café, The Surfing Deer & more*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separatelyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesPrivate Pool is heated from September 1st–April 30th.Interior fireplace is not for guest use.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
